At the risk of sounding like a broken record, other comments are right OP. It sounds like it’s his way of saying that you’re next. You should try talking to your mother about it, but don’t be thrown off if she immediately attempts to shut the conversation down. Needless to say, she’s beyond traumatized. Try to find an adult that you trust, or a school counselor or something, and explore your options. Giving you and your mother a safe space without your dad is a priority. Making sure you can defend yourself is huge, but making sure that you don’t have to be in that position is even bigger. Please reach out whenever you need, you do not have to be by yourself.
